The adjudicated interpretations and product decisions governing the NECB Part 8
pipeline. Runtime code cites these ids through the AuditLog `ruling:` kwarg, and the
AHJ report's rulings appendix renders the ones that actually fired in a run, so a
reader sees WHY a value was chosen without needing access to this repository's
documentation.
kind: runtime          — governs a code path that carries a `ruling:` audit tag

process          — how the project works (authorship, delegation, sign-off, sweeps)

must be cited by at least one `ruling:` literal in Python code.
